page_intro.title: Meetings & Conferences
page_intro.description: Located in Vietnam's leading travel destinations, Vinpearl features luxurious resorts with extensive room capacity, modern convention and dining facilities, and state-of-the-art meeting technology, making it an excellent choice for group and corporate meetings, conferences, and events.

detail.subtitle: Celebrate Success in the Heart of the Paradise Pearl Island
detail.overview: Spanning nearly 11,000 m² in the heart of the Phu Quoc United Center entertainment complex, Vinpearl Convention Center Phu Quoc features magnificent contemporary architecture and promises world-class meeting experiences on the paradise pearl island.

detail.name: Almaz Convention Center Hanoi
detail.subtitle: International-Standard Meetings and Elegant Weddings in the Heart of Hanoi
detail.overview: Designed in a classical Baroque style, Almaz Convention Center Hanoi shines like a magnificent European castle. With modern, international-standard facilities, Almaz is a premier choice for prestigious events and memorable wedding celebrations, offering nine distinct venues with a combined capacity of more than 1,600 guests.

rooms.name: Patio
rooms.description: Another highlight on the first floor is the outdoor Patio beside the lake, surrounded by an open and romantic natural setting. It is an ideal venue for outdoor parties, romantic weddings, and events requiring an open-air space.

rooms.name: Circular Lobby
rooms.description: The central Circular Lobby on the first floor is a dedicated reception area for large functions. Its spacious, elegant setting at the heart of Almaz Convention Center is suitable for networking events, guest receptions, speaker sessions, product exhibitions, fashion shows, and similar programs.

rooms.name: Grand Ballroom
rooms.description: Grand Ballroom is the largest venue, featuring a column-free design and elegant crystal chandeliers. Covering 1,040 m² with a 6.2-meter ceiling and capacity for up to 1,000 guests, it provides a complete and sophisticated setting for important events.

rooms.name: Princess Ballroom
rooms.description: Princess Ballroom features a column-free design and refined crystal lighting similar to Grand Ballroom. With an area of 780 m², a 5.2-meter ceiling, and capacity for 700 guests, it is a premier choice for prestigious events.
